[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-m6[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]One Artifacts contract — every ACE sub-tab, Patch included, behind [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]one declared API[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every ACE Artifacts sub-tab — Patch included — is driven by one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]host-owned ArtifactsPaneContract whose capabilities are derived [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from declared data. A sidecar or artifact repo declares facts in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]its ref spec and inherits querying, relations, grouping, marks, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]copy, help and chrome without shipping code, so a new sub-tab [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]feature is implemented once and appears in every configured [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]provider's tab — including providers belonging to users we will [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never see.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]artifacts_pane_contract.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Live defects, golden fixtures, and the conformance harness[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]foundation[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]freeze golden query/relation/persistence fixtures from current Patch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behavior and stand up the conformance harness every later phase extends.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detail bands render the provider's declared fields[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #5FD7AF] xsmall [/bold black on #5FD7AF]
    [#AF87FF]detail[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]detail: parameterize ordered_plan_property_items by the provider's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]declared ref.detail.fields so a document tab shows its own properties [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of plan properties.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One typed entry target on every pane[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]identity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after foundation[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]identity with a canonical token round-trip, give Patch a row target and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a real navigator, make ArtifactEntryNavigator an ABC, and retire [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]index-based marks and jump anchors.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]ArtifactsPaneContract and derived, explainable capabilities[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]after identity, detail[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]contract: introduce ArtifactsPaneContract with a closed PaneCapability [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vocabulary derived from declared data by named auditable rules, collapse[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every ref-prefix dispatch site onto it, and add the synthetic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]third-party provider fixture.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The shared shell and its visual grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]shell[dim] · [dim][/dim]after contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]shell: build the one chrome every pane renders through, specify and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]implement the five canonical pane states, and replace drifting provider [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accents with a deterministic perceptual palette.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One query engine across every pane and both evaluators[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #AF5FFF] xlarge [/bold white on #AF5FFF]
    [#AF87FF]query[dim] · [dim][/dim]after contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]query: replace three query dialects with one profile-parameterized [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]engine spanning the Rust parser, the Rust batch corpus and the Python [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reference evaluator, move Patch to the inline filter bar, and namespace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]slots, history and selection memory per pane.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Relations, reveal, and grouping as contract features[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]

    [#D7D7AF]declared hierarchy, family and link relations rendered by a host-owned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]panel, make reveal a reversible lens, and put every pane's grouping on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the shared fold registry.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The declarative ref.pane block[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Unified Artifacts keymap with a safe migration[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Conformance, diagnostics, docs, and the performance gate[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]resolved sub-tab including a synthetic provider, ACE-surfaced provider [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostics, the documented contract, and the navigation performance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gate.[/#D7D7AF]
